description:
The story of the anime revolves around Dandy, an alien-hunter. His job is to seek out new aliens never seen before, and receives a reward whenever he finds a new species. His mission is to find those new species faster than anyone else as he travels the galaxy. Together with the bucket-of-bolts robot QT and the dimwit alien Meow he picked up along the way, he comes into contact with new planets and their inhabitants..

(Source: Anime News Network)

node.description: A dandy guy in space who works as an alien hunter. His age is unclear, but he is most likely in his late 20s. He does not care about little things and believes that his dream is somewhere in the world. He frequents "Boobies," a restaurant known for its voluptuous waitresses.

Contrary to expectations, he's not a genetically advanced cat, but he's actually an alien that lives on the planet, Betelgeuse. Meow is very carefree, as if he were raised with no constraints. At times he can come across as excessively lazy, preferring to play video games and read manga instead of working.

A member of Dandy's crew, a robot that resembles and also operates as a vacuum cleaner. QT boasts being more intelligent and competent than its fellow crewmates, but its usefulness is stymied by problems caused by its outdated hardware such as memory shortages and battery outages. Despite being feminine in voice and some of its mannerisms, QT is referred to as a male by Dandy and Meow on several occasions. 

(Source: Wikipedia)
A gorilla-like scientist working for the Gogol Empire, Dr. Gel endlessly pursues Dandy from his spaceship.

The ruler of the Gogol Empire, which is at war with the Jaicro Empire for control of the universe. He sends Dr. Gel to capture Dandy, claiming he is the key to the future of the universe. (Source: Wikipedia)
A blonde-haired waitress working at Boobies. She seems to enjoy the Aloha Oe crew's usual visits.

A collected, no nonsense inspector at the space alien registration center tasked with evaluating the aliens brought by Dandy and paying him accordingly when he brings her a worthy specimen. She is also a skilled fighter and can easily see through Dandy's tricks when he attempts to deceive her. (Source: Wikipedia)

Adélie is a young Gentooan who Dandy meets on Planet Humbolt. Originally hunting her kind for a whopping 8 million woolong reward, Dandy takes a shine to her (and vice versa) and tries to put her in contact with [another Gentooan](https://anilist.co/character/381697/Ojiichan) (her grandfather).

Despite her apparent age, Adélie is feisty, isn't afraid to speak her mind and do what it takes to get what she requires. She does not like to be treated like a child (e.g. demanding an adult train ticket). She was raised only by her mother, who was unmarried and tragically died of sickness, which was the reason why she wanted to find out if her grandpa lived at that apartment.

~!She soon travels with Dandy so that he can send her to the Registration Center to get the money. But, as time goes by and as Adélie spends more time with Dandy, she grows attached to him, as shown when she bursts into tears when she thought Dandy was leaving her. Soon, after Dandy saves her, she wishes to join his crew. When Dandy tells her she's just a kid and that he'll only let her join if she grows up to be a voluptuous woman, she confidently tells herself that she'll grow up fast for him so she can hunt him down and join him once more, showing just how attached she has become to the lewd but kind alien hunter.!~

Being a Gentooan, she has the ability to transfer others' minds and consciousness into puppets. However, she can only perform this once every day for 666 seconds (11 minutes and 6 seconds).

A handsome, blue haired racer adored by young women throughout the galaxy whom Dandy competes against in the Magellanic Nebula Grand Prix. He becomes Dandy's rival patron at BooBies.

(Source: Wikipedia)
The mother of Meow and his siblings. She lives in the family house on Planet Betelgeuse.
The father of Meow and his siblings. He comes from a long line of metalworkers and runs a factory on Planet Betelgeuse, where he lives with his wife and kids.

Toaster is a robot appliance that, like many other robots, was dumped at Dream Island due to developing some form of an emotion that made him unable to do his job. With the arrival of Register and Maker to the island, he and Register made plans to start a revolution against all life forms.
